demo_yaml:
nrf52:
  dfu: true

# --- Buttons: light the matching LED and recolor the matching indicator ---
binary_sensor:
  - platform: gpio
    id: usr1
    name: USR1
    pin:
      number: P1.07
      mode:
        input: true
        pullup: true
      inverted: true
    on_press:
      - switch.turn_on: led_r
      - lvgl.widget.update:
          id: btn1_ind
          bg_color: 0x18BCF2
    on_release:
      - switch.turn_off: led_r
      - lvgl.widget.update:
          id: btn1_ind
          bg_color: 0x3C3C3C

  - platform: gpio
    id: usr2
    name: USR2
    pin:
      number: P0.10
      mode:
        input: true
        pullup: true
      inverted: true
    on_press:
      - switch.turn_on: led_b
      - lvgl.widget.update:
          id: btn2_ind
          bg_color: 0x18BCF2
    on_release:
      - switch.turn_off: led_b
      - lvgl.widget.update:
          id: btn2_ind
          bg_color: 0x3C3C3C

# Marble travel: 45 degrees of tilt moves the marble to the rim (36 px from center).
# To reverse an axis, put a minus sign in front of x in its "Direction" filter.
sensor:
  - platform: motion
    type: pitch
    id: pitch
    filters:
      - lambda: return x;                     # Direction (use -x to reverse)
      - exponential_moving_average:   # light smoothing only (higher alpha = faster)
          alpha: 0.7
          send_every: 1
      - delta: 0.3
    on_value:
      - lvgl.widget.update:
          id: ball
          x: !lambda 'return (int) std::max(-36.0f, std::min(36.0f, x * 36.0f / 45.0f));'   # pitch -> horizontal
      - script.execute: update_level
  - platform: motion
    type: roll
    id: roll
    filters:
      # Roll spans -180..180. If the IMU sits upside down, "flat" reads near
      # +/-180 and would pin the marble to the rim, so fold it back around 0.
      - lambda: 'return x > 90.0f ? x - 180.0f : (x < -90.0f ? x + 180.0f : x);'
      - lambda: return x;                     # Direction (use -x to reverse)
      - exponential_moving_average:   # light smoothing only (higher alpha = faster)
          alpha: 0.7
          send_every: 1
      - delta: 0.3
    on_value:
      - lvgl.widget.update:
          id: ball
          y: !lambda 'return (int) std::max(-36.0f, std::min(36.0f, x * 36.0f / 45.0f));'   # roll -> vertical
      - script.execute: update_level

# Marble and target ring turn green within 2 degrees of level
script:
  - id: update_level
    mode: restart
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return fabsf(id(pitch).state) < 2.0f && fabsf(id(roll).state) < 2.0f;'
          then:
            - lvgl.widget.update:
                id: ball
                bg_color: 0x3CD070
            - lvgl.widget.update:
                id: target
                border_color: 0x3CD070
          else:
            - lvgl.widget.update:
                id: ball
                bg_color: 0x18BCF2
            - lvgl.widget.update:
                id: target
                border_color: 0x3C3C3C

font:
  - file: "gfonts://Roboto@500"
    id: f
    size: 18

# ESPHome vertical logo (color on dark background), downloaded at compile time
image:
  - platform: file
    file: https://media.esphome.io/logo/vertical/Logo%20Vertical%20-%20Color%20on%20Dark%20Background.svg
    id: logo
    type: RGB565
    transparency: alpha_channel
    resize: 140x140

lvgl:
  displays: lcd
  # 12% of the screen = 172 x ~40 lines x 2 bytes ≈ 14 KB.
  # LVGL renders larger dirty areas in several passes through this buffer.
  buffer_size: 12%
  pages:
    - id: main_page
      bg_color: 0x000000
      scrollable: false
      widgets:
        - image:
            src: logo
            align: TOP_MID
            y: 8

        # Spirit-level dish: 96 px circle, y 154..250
        - obj:
            id: dish
            align: TOP_MID
            y: 154
            width: 96
            height: 96
            radius: 48
            pad_all: 0
            bg_color: 0x0E1A22
            border_width: 2
            border_color: 0x3C3C3C
            scrollable: false
            widgets:
              # "Level" target zone
              - obj:
                  id: target
                  align: CENTER
                  width: 26
                  height: 26
                  radius: 13
                  pad_all: 0
                  bg_opa: TRANSP
                  border_width: 2
                  border_color: 0x3C3C3C
                  scrollable: false
              # The marble (x/y are offsets from the dish center)
              - obj:
                  id: ball
                  align: CENTER
                  x: 0
                  y: 0
                  width: 18
                  height: 18
                  radius: 9
                  pad_all: 0
                  border_width: 0
                  bg_color: 0x18BCF2
                  scrollable: false

        # Zigbee status: grey "starting" -> amber "searching" -> green "joined"
        - label:
            id: zb_label
            align: TOP_MID
            y: 256
            text_font: f
            text_color: 0x8C8C8C
            text: "Zigbee: starting"

        # Button indicators: 24 px circles centered at (50,296) and (122,296)
        - obj:
            id: btn1_ind
            x: 38
            y: 284
            width: 24
            height: 24
            radius: 12
            pad_all: 0
            border_width: 0
            bg_color: 0x3C3C3C
            scrollable: false
            widgets:
              - label:
                  align: CENTER
                  text_font: f
                  text_color: 0xFFFFFF
                  text: "1"

        - obj:
            id: btn2_ind
            x: 110
            y: 284
            width: 24
            height: 24
            radius: 12
            pad_all: 0
            border_width: 0
            bg_color: 0x3C3C3C
            scrollable: false
            widgets:
              - label:
                  align: CENTER
                  text_font: f
                  text_color: 0xFFFFFF
                  text: "2"

# Backlight as a number (0-100 %) so it is exposed over Zigbee
# (lights are not supported by the Zigbee component).
number:
  - platform: template
    id: backlight
    name: Backlight
    unit_of_measurement: "%"
    min_value: 0
    max_value: 100
    step: 25                     # only 0, 25, 50, 75, 100
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true          # remember brightness across reboots
    initial_value: 100
    on_value:                    # also fires at boot with the restored value
      - output.set_level:
          id: backlight_output
          # Panel brightness saturates near 20 % duty, so the steps are spaced
          # roughly geometrically (~2.8x each) below that point.
          level: !lambda |-
            switch ((int) roundf(x / 25.0f)) {
              case 0:  return 0.0f;     //   0 % -> off
              case 1:  return 0.025f;   //  25 % -> 2.5 % duty
              case 2:  return 0.07f;    //  50 % -> 7 % duty
              case 3:  return 0.20f;    //  75 % -> 20 % duty
              default: return 1.0f;     // 100 % -> full
            }

zigbee:
  id: my_zigbee
  # Stack is up and trying to (re-)join a network
  on_start:
    - lvgl.label.update:
        id: zb_label
        text: "Zigbee: searching"
        text_color: 0xF2B418
  # x is true for a fresh join, false for a rejoin
  on_join:
    - switch.turn_on: led_g
    - lvgl.label.update:
        id: zb_label
        text:
          format: "Zigbee: %s"
          args: ['x ? "joined" : "rejoined"']
        text_color: 0x3CD070
description: Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 paired with a 1.47" 172x320 IPS SPI display, a 6-axis LSM6DS IMU, two user buttons and an RGB status LED. New devices start from a Zigbee demo: an LVGL spirit level driven by the IMU, button indicators and a dimmable backlight exposed over Zigbee.

featured_bundles.description: SPI bus, 1.47" IPS panel and PWM backlight.
featured_bundles.name: Display (full setup)

name: Seeed XIAO 1.47" IPS Touch Display (nRF52840)
